==Description==
'''Glass''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that only appears in [[Challenge Trials]], after [[Speedy Enemies]] and before [[Quarantine]]. When a [[Challenge Trials|Challenge Trial]] with this modifier is beaten, it will be unlocked for the player to apply on any match.

'''Glass''' is part of a group of six modifiers consisting of itself, [[Exploding Enemies]], [[Limitation Makes Creativity]], [[Committed]], [[Speedy Enemies]] and [[Flying Enemies]]. These six modifiers cannot have their total reward boost exceed 50%, limiting their boosts to that. This does not prevent modifiers not part of this group from applying their boosts. For example, [[Fog]] will still apply its 20% reward boost when all six are applied, increasing the reward boost from 50% to 70%, though still lower from the expected 95%.

==Effects==
When applied, the base health is reduced down to one health. Additionally, the base health also cannot be overhealed while it is active.

==Trivia==
*This modifier can be used into triggering [[Hidden Wave]] as it reduces the base health to one, one of the conditions required for triggering the [[Hidden Wave]].

==Update History==

*'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]]

**Cap for total reward boost from '''Glass''', [[Limitation Makes Creativity]], [[Exploding Enemies]], [[Speedy Enemies]], [[Flying Enemies]] and [[Committed]] expanded to all gamemodes.
